parameters.name: ClientIds
parameters.description: The IDs of Cloud Backup clients. The total number of Cloud Backup client IDs and ECS instance IDs cannot exceed 100.

parameters.name: CrossAccountRoleName
parameters.description: The name of the RAM role that is created within the source Alibaba Cloud account and assigned to the current Alibaba Cloud account to authorize the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts.

parameters.name: CrossAccountType
parameters.description:
Specifies whether data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account or across Alibaba Cloud accounts. Valid values:

*   SELF_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account.
*   CROSS_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up across Alibaba Cloud accounts.

parameters.name: CrossAccountUserId
parameters.description: The ID of the source Alibaba Cloud account that authorizes the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The IDs of Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances. The total number of ECS instance IDs and Cloud Backup client IDs cannot exceed 100.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr upgrade-backup-clients --instance-ids '[c-000000000000000000000]' --client-ids '[i-0xi5wj0000003j3bh2gj5]' --cross-account-type CROSS_ACCOUNT --cross-account-user-id 1283948272 --cross-account-role-name hbrcrossrole --region cn-hangzhou
